1 分钟一个周期，曾用于 EME 月面反射与 HF 小功率；现已淘汰，EME 改: A one-minute cycle, once used for EME (moonbounce) and low-power HF; now obsolete — EME uses Q65 instead (the two are incompatible).
15 秒一个周期的弱信号数字模式，能在很弱的信号下完成简短通联。: A weak-signal digital mode with a 15-second cycle; completes short contacts in very weak signal.
31.25 波特的窄带相移键控文字聊天模式。: A narrowband phase-shift-keying text chat mode at 31.25 baud.
7.5 秒一个周期，适合竞赛等快速交换的弱信号模式。: A weak-signal mode with a 7.5-second cycle, suited to fast exchanges such as contests.
APRS / WSPR —— 广播位置或探测传播。: APRS / WSPR — broadcast position or probe propagation.
FT4 / RTTY —— 周期短、交换快。: FT4 / RTTY — short cycles, fast exchanges.
FT8 / FT4 / Q65 —— 极低信噪比下可靠解码。: FT8 / FT4 / Q65 — reliable decoding at very low SNR.
JS8Call / PSK31 / RTTY —— 逐字实时交流。: JS8Call / PSK31 / RTTY — character-by-character real-time conversation.
Q65 —— 对极弱信号与多普勒优化（JT65 已淘汰，与 Q65 不兼容）。: Q65 — optimised for extremely weak signals and Doppler (JT65 is obsolete and incompatible with Q65).
VARA HF / VARA FM 自适应速率 ARQ 调制，Winlink 无: VARA HF / VARA FM adaptive-rate ARQ modulation, widely used for Winlink radio mail.
Winlink（Pactor / ARDOP / VARA）—— 收发电子邮件。: Winlink (Pactor / ARDOP / VARA) — send and receive e-mail.
八重洲 System Fusion，采用 C4FM 调制，可与模拟调频兼容。: Yaesu System Fusion using C4FM modulation; compatible with analogue FM.
在话音带宽内逐行传送静止图像，国际空间站常开展 SSTV 活动。: Sends still images line by line within the voice bandwidth; the ISS often runs SSTV events.
基于 FT8 的信号结构，支持键盘实时文字聊天。: Based on the FT8 signal structure; supports real-time keyboard text chat.
基于开源 Codec2 声码器，可在 HF 窄带中传输数字话音。: Based on the open-source Codec2 vocoder; carries digital voice in a narrow HF bandwidth.
完全开源的新一代数字语音与数据协议，基于 Codec2 声码器，面向开放生态。: A fully open-source next-generation digital voice and data protocol built on the Codec2 vocoder, aimed at an open ecosystem.
开源声卡 ARQ 调制，可作为 PACTOR 的替代用于 Winlink。: An open-source soundcard ARQ modulation, usable as a PACTOR replacement for Winlink.
把数据分成带地址的数据包传输，常用 AX.25 协议。: Transmits data in addressed packets, usually with the AX.25 protocol.
日本业余无线电联盟制定的数字语音与数据标准，支持中继台联网。: A digital voice and data standard defined by the Japan Amateur Radio League; supports repeater networking.
欧洲电信标准协会标准，采用时分多址，一个信道可同时传两路语音。: An ETSI standard using TDMA: one channel carries two simultaneous voice streams.
用频移键控传送文字，业余常用 45.45 波特、频移 170Hz。: Transmits text by frequency-shift keying; amateurs commonly use 45.45 baud with 170 Hz shift.
硬件 TNC 的 HF ARQ 协议，PACTOR 4 传输能力强，需专用调制解: An HF ARQ protocol for hardware TNCs; PACTOR 4 has high throughput and needs a dedicated modem.
超窄带弱信号信标模式，用于探测与报告电波传播。: An ultra-narrowband weak-signal beacon mode used to probe and report propagation.
通过分组数据自动上报位置和短信息，国内常用 144.640MHz。: Automatically reports position and short messages via packet data; 144.640 MHz is commonly used domestically.
面向 EME 与极弱信号的现代模式，子模式可调；取代 JT65（两者不兼容）。: A modern mode for EME and extremely weak signals with selectable sub-modes; replaces JT65 (the two are incompatible).
